title: Sort the library by Recently Played / Most Played
description: Two new sort options driven by the local play-session recorder: Recently Played (a game's last session end, never-played sinking to the bottom) and Most Played (total recorded time). These are the two launchers' most-used sorts (Steam, Playnite) - now backed by ground truth instead of nothing.
commit_message: Add Recently Played and Most Played library sorts
author: prepare-chain:claude
